title: Brimbelle: De la Ferme au Marché
original_title: Brimbelle: De la Ferme au Marché
overview: Young families will be charmed by this story and catchy new songs that let them discover how delicious local products make their way to market. While having fun, children learn more about farm work, animals, and local foods. An educational and entertaining experience with Brimbelle and the mascot Foin-Foin the farmer!
